responsibilities.responsibility: Immutable Android Gateway actor/execution routing context
responsibilities.old_owner: PlayniteTransitionGateway childSession boolean plus parent-default connect overloads; several Game callers re-read mutable Activity intent inside delayed work
responsibilities.new_owner: PlayniteTransitionGateway.ActorContext, bound once to the canonical actor-profile GatewayConnection
effects_moved: selection of parent health plus gameplay reads versus child-scoped gameplay reads
binding of the canonical X-WakePlay-Profile value through GatewayConnection
obsolete_paths_removed: connect(Context, hostId, activeHost, profileId, boolean childSession)
responsibilities.production_wiring_evidence: The only remaining public connect method requires ActorContext. Game captures context before retained switch, game stop, full quit, overlay end-game and suspend async boundaries. Production-facade tests record exact route/profile order; the real Gateway handler tests child allow/deny behavior.
responsibilities.packaging_evidence: S01-ANDROID-PACKAGE-WIRING finds PlayniteTransitionGateway in the debug APK dex, ActorContext in the release R8 mapping, and classes.dex in the release APK.
responsibilities.lifetime_notes: ActorContext is final and immutable for one facade/operation. GatewayConnection remains the credential-bearing request descriptor; GatewayTransport remains the sole TLS/auth/profile-header executor. Host resolves the child actor to its execution profile and remains authoritative.

remaining_monolith_responsibilities: Game still owns host termination orchestration and physical stream completion; these pre-existing responsibilities remain assigned to S04/S05.
ConsoleActivity retains broader profile and launch composition responsibilities assigned to later slices.
test_seam: HostGatewayClient remains package-private; its request method is package-visible and class non-final only so the existing PlayniteTransitionGateway production path can be exercised with a recording request boundary. Production construction still uses the unchanged GatewayTransport.
